ns2:section.sectionText: [Long title: The School Library Media Center: Curriculum, Collaboration and Connection] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with the consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu). Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit (2 or 4 hours). Required on-campus section Sunday, March 8. See section description for at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html .
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
